tasks.label: Debug build
tasks.command: cmake -B build-debug -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build-debug && echo "WEBCAM_SOURCE=tcp://$(ip route show default | awk '{print $3}'):5000" > .vscode/stream.env

tasks.label: Start camera stream (Windows)
tasks.command: '/mnt/c/Users/Owner/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/Gyan.FFmpeg_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe/ffmpeg-9.0.2-full_build/bin/ffmpeg.exe' -hide_banner -loglevel error -rtbufsize 100M -f dshow -video_size 1280x720 -framerate 30 -i 'video=Display AI Camera' -vcodec libx264 -preset ultrafast -tune zerolatency -f mpegts 'tcp://0.0.0.0:5000?listen'
